name: Roasted Eggplant With Tahini, Pine Nuts, and Lentils
assumptions: Recipe serves 4 based on 2 large eggplants and 12oz lentils as main components, consistent with original Serious Eats source for 4 servings.
Total time estimated at 60 minutes from instructions: ~10 min prep for lentils/veg, 30 min simmer, ~30 min roast (overlapping), plus 4-5 min toasting and assembly.
Tahini sauce mentioned in instructions but not in provided ingredients list; conservatively classified as introducing sesame (true) but not adding other allergens or diet incompatibilities.
No animal products, gluten sources, dairy, eggs, fish, or shellfish in listed ingredients.
Pine nuts classified as tree nuts (true).
All herbs, vinegar, oil, and vegetables treated as gluten-free and compatible with listed diets.
Water, salt, pepper, and bay leaves have no impact on classifications.
instructions:
For the Lentils: Adjust oven rack to center position and preheat oven to 450°F to prepare for roasting eggplant. Meanwhile, heat 2 tablespoons olive oil in a medium saucepan over medium heat until shimmering. Add carrots, celery, and onion and cook, stirring, until softened but not browned, about 4 minutes. Add garlic and cook, stirring, until fragrant, about 30 seconds. Add lentils, bay leaves, stock or water, and a pinch of salt. Bring to a simmer, cover with the lid partially ajar, and cook until lentils are tender, about 30 minutes. (Top up with water if lentils are at any point not fully submerged.) Remove lid, stir in vinegar, and reduce until lentils are moist but not soupy. Season to taste with salt and pepper, cover, and keep warm until ready to serve.

2.
For the Eggplant: While lentils cook, cut each eggplant in half. Score flesh with the tip of a paring knife in a cross-hatch pattern at 1-inch intervals. Transfer to a foil-lined rimmed baking sheet, cut side up, and brush each eggplant half with 1 tablespoon oil, letting each brushstroke be fully absorbed before brushing with more. Season with salt and pepper. Place a rosemary sprig on top of each one. Transfer to oven and roast until completely tender and well charred, 25 to 35 minutes. Remove from oven and discard rosemary.

3.
To Serve: Heat 2 tablespoons olive oil and pine nuts in a medium skillet set over medium heat. Cook, tossing nuts frequently, until golden brown and aromatic, about 4 minutes. Transfer to a bowl to halt cooking. Stir half of parsley and rosemary into lentils and transfer to a serving platter. Arrange eggplant halves on top. Spread a few tablespoons of tahini sauce over each eggplant half and sprinkle with pine nuts. Sprinkle with remaining parsley and rosemary, drizzle with additional olive oil, and serve.

ingredients.name: Carrots
ingredients.assumptions: 2 small carrots (about 80g total); typical peeled and chunked weight for recipe.

ingredients.name: Celery
ingredients.assumptions: 2 small celery stalks (about 60g total); typical trimmed weight.

ingredients.name: Onion
ingredients.assumptions: 1 medium onion (about 110g); typical finely diced cooking onion weight.

ingredients.name: Garlic
ingredients.assumptions: 6 medium garlic cloves (about 18g total); typical sliced cloves weight.

ingredients.name: Brown Lentils
ingredients.assumptions: 12 oz (340g) dry brown lentils as listed; raw/dry state before cooking in instructions.

ingredients.name: Bay Leaves
ingredients.assumptions: 2 bay leaves; negligible edible weight and nutrition.

ingredients.name: Water
ingredients.assumptions: 4 cups water; used for simmering lentils (fully absorbed or discarded in final moist lentils, nutrition zero).

ingredients.name: Salt
ingredients.assumptions: Pinch of salt; negligible weight and nutrition (standard table salt).

ingredients.name: Apple Cider Vinegar
ingredients.assumptions: 2 tsp (10ml) apple cider vinegar; standard density ~1g/ml.

ingredients.name: Pepper
ingredients.assumptions: Pinch of pepper; negligible weight and nutrition (standard black pepper).

ingredients.name: Egg Plants
ingredients.assumptions: 2 large eggplants (about 500g each raw/edible flesh and skin; typical roasted weight before char/discard).

ingredients.name: Rosemary
ingredients.assumptions: 4 rosemary sprigs (used in roasting then discarded); negligible edible weight and nutrition in final dish.

ingredients.name: Pine nuts
ingredients.assumptions: 1/4 cup pine nuts; standard ~34g for dry measure, toasted in recipe.

ingredients.name: Parsley
ingredients.assumptions: 2 tbsp chopped parsley; typical fresh herb weight.
